source.notes: Dungeon landblocks: the first 4 (x ascending, then y) whose LandblockInfo has at least 20 cells and no buildings, plus the outdoor A9B4. For every 3rd env cell (and A9B4's cell 0x0001): the point = the env cell's frame origin + (0.1, 0.1, 0.5), given in cell landblock|0x0100 (A9B4: |0x0001). Output: cells_result/cells_pos (AdjustDungeonCells on a copy), pos_result/pos_pos (AdjustDungeonPos on a copy), adjust_pos (AdjustDungeon on a copy).
